phases.name: Curve and subgroup
phases.what: Point count, factoring #E, generator, cofactor clearing

phases.name: Workflow constructions
phases.what: Orbit maps, point index, collectors and solvers built around the work (Koblitz rows)

phases.name: Factor base
phases.what: Choose and materialise the base points, or their orbit representatives

phases.name: Pair table
phases.what: Every pair sum of the base, stored for meet-in-the-middle lookups

phases.name: Relations (PDP)
phases.what: Draw targets and decompose each over the base: the point decomposition problem

phases.name: Linear algebra
phases.what: Eliminate over Z/rZ until the target's column, or every base log, is pinned

phases.name: Descent
phases.what: Decompose each target over the logged base (Koblitz rows; the ladder puts the target in the matrix)

phases.name: Verification
phases.what: Re-add every relation and check [d]G = Q
